spec.ticket_text:
Add GET /issues: the caller's org's issues across all projects.
Optional filters, combined with AND: status (open|in_progress|done), priority (low|medium|high),
assignee_id, project_id, q (1-100 chars, case-insensitive substring of the title).
Exclude deleted issues and issues in archived projects. A project_id or assignee_id from another org
is 404 not_found; an invalid value is 422 validation_error. Any role may read. Items are IssueOut;
the usual cursor/limit list envelope.
Spec: docs/features/f1.md.
